q: How do I count emissions from employees' mileage claims for business trips in their own cars?
title: Mileage claims for business travel
short: They are Scope 3 Category 6, business travel. Take the kilometres from each claim, split by car or two-wheeler and fuel, and apply a per-km factor or convert to litres with a typical mileage. Commuting to the usual workplace is Category 7, so keep it out.
audience: HR and finance teams in MSMEs

ul: Kilometres per claim, already on most reimbursement forms.
Vehicle type: car, two-wheeler, petrol, diesel or CNG.
Trip purpose, to separate business travel from commuting.

p: Per-km factors from a published table, or kilometres divided by mileage to get litres, then the fuel factor.

example.title: One month of claims
lines: Petrol cars: 1,200 km at 15 km per litre = 80 L
